data.gender_notes: Addiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew roots ‘Ad’ (God) and ‘Dalet’ (path or way), this name signifies that God is the source of righteousness and the one who guides the way. In the Old Testament, Addai is mentioned as a high priest and a prophet, while Addir is a place name. This name is popular in various Western cultures, including English-speaking countries.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the belief that God provides righteousness and guidance in life.
data.etymology: Addiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is my righteousness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Addiel total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
